translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Deng Ying, Concurrent Attendant Cadet, went to Liu Yilong as envoy.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，車駕至濡水。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiwei: the imperial carriage reached the Ru River.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, the court reached the Ru River.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣安東將軍、宜城公奚斤發幽州民及密雲丁零萬餘人，運攻具，出南道，俱會和龍。

translations.literal: On gengshen an edict that General Who Pacifies the East, Duke of Yicheng Xi Jin, was to mobilize the people of You province and more than ten thousand Dingling of Miyun, transport siege engines, and go by the southern route to join at Helong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he ordered Xi Jin, General Who Pacifies the East and Duke of Yicheng, to raise the people of You and more than ten thousand Miyun Dingling with siege gear by the southern road to Helong.

sentences.zh: 帝至遼西，文通遣其侍御史崔聘奉獻牛酒。

translations.literal: The Emperor reached Liaoxi; Wentong sent his attendant censor Cui Pin with cattle and wine as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Liaoxi, Wentong sent Cui Pin with cattle and wine.

sentences.zh: 己巳，車駕至和龍，臨其城。

translations.literal: On jisi the imperial carriage reached Helong and came before the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the court reached Helong and stood before the walls.

sentences.zh: 文通石城太守李崇、建德太守王融十餘郡來降，發其民三萬人穿圍塹以守之。

translations.literal: Li Chong, Administrator of Shicheng, Wang Rong, Administrator of Jiande, and more than ten commanderies came over; their people, thirty thousand, were set to dig encircling trenches for the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chong of Shicheng, Wang Rong of Jiande, and more than ten districts submitted; thirty thousand of their people dug siege trenches.

sentences.zh: 是月，築東宮。

translations.literal: That month the Eastern Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Eastern Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，文通使數萬人出城挑戰，昌黎公元丘與河間公元齊擊破之，死者萬餘人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: Wentong sent tens of thousands of men out to challenge battle; Yuan Qiu of Changli and Yuan Qi of Hejian routed them; more than ten thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the eighth month Wentong sent tens of thousands to fight; Yuan Qiu and Yuan Qi broke them and killed more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 文通尚書高紹率萬餘家保羌胡固。

translations.literal: Gao Shao, Wentong's Master of Writing, led more than ten thousand households to hold the Qiang-Hu fort.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shao, Wentong's Master of Writing, held a Qiang-Hu fort with more than ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕討紹，辛巳，斬之。

translations.literal: On jimao the imperial carriage attacked Shao; on xinsi he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the court attacked Shao; on xinsi he was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 詔平東將軍賀多羅攻文通帶方太守慕容玄於猴固，撫軍大將軍、永昌王健攻建德，驃騎大將軍、樂平王丕攻冀陽，皆拔之，虜獲生口，班賜將士各有差。

translations.literal: An edict that General Who Pacifies the East He Duoluo was to attack Wentong's Administrator of Daifang Murong Xuan at Hou Fort; Grand General Who Inspires Awe, Prince of Yongchang Jian, was to attack Jiande; General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Leping Pi, was to attack Jiyang—all were taken, captives seized, and the generals rewarded each according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: He Duoluo took Murong Xuan at Hou Fort; Prince Jian of Yongchang took Jiande; Prince Pi of Leping took Jiyang; captives were divided among the troops by merit.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，車駕西還。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao: the imperial carriage returned west.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the ninth month the court turned west.

sentences.zh: 徙營丘、成周、遼東、樂浪、帶方、玄菟六郡民三萬家于幽州，開倉以賑之。

translations.literal: The people of Yingqiu, Chengzhou, Liaodong, Lelang, Daifang, and Xuantu—thirty thousand households—were moved to You province; granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty thousand households from six northeastern commands were moved to You; granaries were opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，車駕至濡水。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiyou: the imperial carriage reached the Ru River.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the tenth month of winter the court reached the Ru River.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾慕璝遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Murong Mugui of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Mugui sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十有一月乙巳，車駕至自伐和龍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi: the imperial carriage returned from the campaign against Helong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the eleventh month the court returned from Helong.

sentences.zh: 十有二月己丑，馮文通長樂公崇及其母弟朗、朗弟邈，以遼西內屬。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jichou: Feng Chong, Duke of Changle, and his mother and younger brother Lang, and Lang's younger brother Miao, submitted Liaoxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Feng Chong of Changle, his mother, Lang, and Miao brought Liaoxi over.

sentences.zh: 文通遣將封羽圍遼西。

translations.literal: Wentong sent the general Feng Yu to besiege Liaoxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wentong sent Feng Yu to besiege Liaoxi.

sentences.zh: 先是，辟召賢良，而州郡多逼遣之。

translations.literal: Earlier, worthies had been summoned, but provinces and commanderies often forced them to come.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier worthies had been summoned, but local officials often forced them out.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕除偽平暴，征討累年，思得英賢，緝熙治道，故詔州郡搜揚隱逸，進舉賢俊。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We have removed the false and pacified violence, campaigning for years, seeking worthy men to illumine government; therefore provinces and commanderies were ordered to search out the hidden and advance the able.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "We have fought for years seeking able men to govern; provinces were told to find the hidden and promote talent."

sentences.zh: 古之君子，養志衡門，德成業就，才為世使。

translations.literal: The gentlemen of old nurtured their will behind closed gates; when virtue was complete and work achieved, their talent served the age.
translations.idiomatic: Men of old kept their will at home; when ready, they served the state."

sentences.zh: 或雍容雅步，三命而後至；

translations.literal: Some came with easy grace only after three summons;
translations.idiomatic: Some came slowly, only after repeated calls;"

sentences.zh: 或棲棲遑遑，負鼎而自達。

translations.literal: some hurried in haste, carrying the cauldron to present themselves.
translations.idiomatic: others hurried forward bearing the cauldron themselves."

sentences.zh: 雖徇尚不同，濟時一也。

translations.literal: Though their paths differed, the aim of aiding the time was one.
translations.idiomatic: Different paths served the same end."

sentences.zh: 諸召人皆當以禮申諭，任其進退，何逼遣之有也！

translations.literal: All summoned men are to be instructed with ceremony and allowed to come or go as they choose—why force them?
translations.idiomatic: Every summoned man shall be told with full courtesy and left free to come or go—why compel them?"

sentences.zh: 此刺史、守宰宣揚失旨，豈復光益，乃所以彰朕不德。

translations.literal: These governors and magistrates have failed to proclaim Our intent; they bring no added light but only display Our want of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: These governors have misrepresented Our intent and shown Our lack of virtue rather than Our praise."

sentences.zh: 自今以後，各令鄉閭推舉，守宰但宣朕虛心求賢之意。

translations.literal: From now on let village and district recommend; magistrates need only declare Our sincere search for the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth let communities recommend; officials need only announce Our search for talent."

sentences.zh: 既至，當待以不次之舉，隨才文武，任之政事。

translations.literal: When they arrive they shall receive exceptional promotion; according to civil or martial talent they shall be placed in government.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival they shall be raised without waiting for routine rank and set to civil or military office as fit."

sentences.zh: 其明宣敕，咸使聞知。」

translations.literal: Proclaim this edict clearly so all may hear."
translations.idiomatic: Let this edict be proclaimed until all have heard."

sentences.zh: 是年，禿髮傉檀子保周棄沮渠蒙遜來奔，以保周為張掖公。

translations.literal: That year Tufa Rutan's son Baozhou abandoned Juqu Mengxun and came in flight; Baozhou was made Duke of Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: That year Baozhou, son of Tufa Rutan, fled from Juqu Mengxun and was made Duke of Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙卯，撫軍大將軍、永昌王健督諸軍救遼西。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, day yimao: Grand General Who Inspires Awe, Prince of Yongchang Jian, directed the armies to relieve Liaoxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month of spring, on yimao Prince Jian of Yongchang led the armies to save Liaoxi.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以樂安王範為假節、加侍中、都督秦雍涇梁益五州諸軍事、衞大將軍、儀同三司，鎮長安。

translations.literal: On bingyin Prince of Le'an Fan was made Acting Grand Master of Ceremonies with staff, Commander of Qin, Yong, Jing, Liang, and Yi provinces, General of the Guard with equal ceremony to the Three Excellencies, and garrisoned Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Fan, Prince of Le'an, was given western command and garrisoned Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，詔兼鴻臚卿李繼，持節假馮崇車騎大將軍、遼西王，承制聽置尚書已下；

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu: an edict that Concurrent Director of Ceremonial Affairs Li Ji, bearing credentials, was to make Feng Chong Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and King of Liaoxi, with authority to appoint offices through the Masters of Writing;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Li Ji was sent to invest Feng Chong as King of Liaoxi with power to staff his court;

sentences.zh: 賜崇功臣爵秩各有差。

translations.literal: Chong and his meritorious followers were enfeoffed and ranked each according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Chong and his followers were enfeoffed by merit.

sentences.zh: 征西將軍金崖與安定鎮將延普及涇州刺史狄子玉爭權構隙，舉兵攻普，不克，退保胡空谷，驅掠平民，據險自固。

translations.literal: General Who Conquers the West Jin Ya and Yanpu, garrison commander of Anding, and Governor of Jingzhou Di Ziyu contended for power and raised troops against Yanpu; they did not prevail, withdrew to hold Hukong Valley, drove off civilians, and entrenched on difficult ground.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Ya, General Who Conquers the West, quarreled with Yanpu of Anding and Di Ziyu of Jing; failing to win, they held Hukong Valley, looted civilians, and fortified the heights.

sentences.zh: 詔散騎常侍、平西將軍、安定鎮將陸俟討獲之。

translations.literal: An edict that Attendant Cadet, General Who Pacifies the West, and garrison commander of Anding Lu Si was to campaign and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Lu Si, Attendant Cadet and commander of Anding, to take them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，行幸河西。

translations.literal: On renwu traveled to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 詔兼散騎常侍宋宣使於劉義隆。

translations.literal: An edict that Concurrent Attendant Cadet Song Xuan was envoy to Liu Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Song Xuan, Concurrent Attendant Cadet, to Liu Yilong.

sentences.zh: 丙申，馮崇母弟朗來朝。

translations.literal: On bingshen Feng Chong's younger brother Lang came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Lang, Feng Chong's brother, came to court.

sentences.zh: 三月，司馬德宗驃騎將軍司馬元顯子天助來降。

translations.literal: Third month: Tian Zhu, son of Sima Yuanxian, Grand General of Agile Cavalry to Sima Dezong, came over.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Tian Zhu, son of Sima Yuanxian, came over from the Jin court.

sentences.zh: 壬子，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On renzi the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏五月己亥，行幸山北。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day jihai: traveled to north of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the fifth month of summer he went north of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 六月，遣撫軍大將軍、永昌王健，尚書左僕射安原督諸軍討和龍。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Grand General Who Inspires Awe, Prince of Yongchang Jian, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing An Yuan directed the armies to campaign against Helong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Prince Jian of Yongchang and An Yuan led the armies against Helong.

sentences.zh: 將軍樓勃別將五千騎圍凡城，[4]文通守將封羽以城降，收其民三千餘家。

translations.literal: General Lou Bo separately led five thousand horse to besiege Fancheng; [4] Feng Yu, Wentong's garrison commander, surrendered the city and more than three thousand households were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Bo led five thousand horse to besiege Fancheng; [4] Feng Yu, Wentong's commander, surrendered the city and more than three thousand households were taken.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔樂安王範發秦、雍兵一萬人，築小城於長安城內。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict that Prince of Le'an Fan was to mobilize ten thousand troops of Qin and Yong and build a small city within Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he ordered Fan, Prince of Le'an, to raise ten thousand men of Qin and Yong and build an inner citadel at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，遼西王馮崇上表，求說降其父，帝不聽。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month: Feng Chong, King of Liaoxi, submitted a memorial asking to persuade his father to surrender; the Emperor did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn Feng Chong asked leave to persuade his father to submit; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 九月，劉義隆遣使朝貢，奉馴象一。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute, presenting one trained elephant.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Liu Yilong sent tribute, including a trained elephant.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔兼大鴻臚卿崔賾持節拜征虜將軍楊難當為征南大將軍、儀同三司，封南秦王。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict that Concurrent Director of Ceremonial Affairs Cui Yi, bearing credentials, was to invest General Who Conquers the Barbarians Yang Nachang as General Who Conquers the South, equal ceremony to the Three Excellencies, and King of Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Cui Yi invested Yang Nachang as King of Southern Qin with rank equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，南秦王楊難當率眾圍漢中。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Yang Nachang, King of Southern Qin, led his host to besiege Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Yang Nachang, King of Southern Qin, besieged Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十有一月甲寅，車駕自山北還宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiayin: the imperial carriage returned from north of the mountains to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the eleventh month the court returned from the northern mountains.

sentences.zh: 十有二月己巳，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jisi: general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the twelfth month he granted amnesty to the empire.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸陰山之北。

translations.literal: On xinwei he traveled to north of the Yin Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he went north of the Yin Mountains.

sentences.zh: 隴西休屠王弘祖率眾內屬。

translations.literal: Hong Zu, King of Xiutu in Longxi, led his people inward in submission.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Zu, Xiutu king in Longxi, submitted with his people.

sentences.zh: 金崖既死，部人立崖從弟當川領其眾。

translations.literal: Jin Ya having died, his tribesmen installed his younger cousin from the clan Dangchuan to lead the host.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin Ya died his people set his cousin Dangchuan over them.

sentences.zh: 詔兼散騎常侍盧玄使於劉義隆。

translations.literal: An edict that Concurrent Attendant Cadet Lu Xuan was envoy to Liu Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Lu Xuan, Concurrent Attendant Cadet, to Liu Yilong.

sentences.zh: 是歲，沮渠蒙遜死，以其子牧犍為車騎將軍，改封河西王。

translations.literal: That year Juqu Mengxun died; his son Mujian was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and re-enfeoffed as King of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: That year Juqu Mengxun died; his son Mujian became General of Chariots and Cavalry and King of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月乙未，車駕次于女水，大饗羣臣，班賜各有差。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, day yimao: the imperial carriage halted at Nüshui, held a great feast for the ministers, and distributed rewards each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month of spring, on yimao the court halted at Nüshui, feasted the ministers, and gave rewards by rank.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，馮文通遣其給事黃門侍郎伊臣乞和，帝不許。

translations.literal: On wuxu Feng Wentong sent his Attendant of Affairs Huangmen Attendant Yichen to beg peace; the Emperor did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Wentong sent Yichen to sue for peace; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，金當川反。

translations.literal: On bingchen Jin Dangchuan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Dangchuan rebelled.

sentences.zh: 楊難當克漢中，送雍州流民七千家于長安。

translations.literal: Yang Nachang took Hanzhong and sent seven thousand displaced households of Yong province to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Nachang took Hanzhong and sent seven thousand refugees from Yong to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，蠕蠕吳提奉其妹，并遣其異母兄禿鹿傀及左右數百人朝貢，獻馬二千匹。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingmao: Rouran Wuti presented his sister and sent his half-brother Tulu Gui and several hundred attendants with tribute, presenting two thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the second month Wuti of the Rouran sent his sister, his half-brother Tulu Gui, and hundreds of attendants with two thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔曰：「朕承統之始，羣凶縱逸，四方未賓，所在逆僭。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict said: "At the beginning of Our succession the wicked ran wild; the four quarters were not subject; everywhere there was usurpation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict said: "When We began to rule, rebels ran wild and the four quarters would not submit."

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕陸梁於漠北，鐵弗肆虐於三秦。

translations.literal: The Rouran were overbearing north of the desert; the Tiefe ravaged the three Qins.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran lorded the northern desert; the Tiefe ravaged the three Qins."

sentences.zh: 是以旰食忘寢，抵掌扼腕，期在掃清逋殘，寧濟萬宇。

translations.literal: Therefore We ate late and forgot sleep, clapped hands and gripped wrists, resolved to sweep away the lingering rebels and bring peace to the myriad realms.
translations.idiomatic: We ate late and slept little, bent on clearing the remnant rebels and pacifying the realm."

sentences.zh: 故頻年屢征，有事西北，運輸之役，百姓勤勞，廢失農業，遭離水旱，致使生民貧富不均，未得家給人足，或有寒窮不能自贍者，朕甚愍焉。

translations.literal: Therefore for years campaigns were repeated in the northwest; transport duties wore out the people, agriculture was neglected, flood and drought followed, and rich and poor were unequal—the people did not have enough for household and person; some were cold and poor and could not support themselves—We are deeply grieved.
translations.idiomatic: Years of northwestern war and transport broke the farmers; flood and drought followed; rich and poor diverged and some could not live—We grieve for them."

sentences.zh: 今四方順軌，兵革漸寧，宜寬徭賦，與民休息。

translations.literal: Now the four quarters follow the track and arms gradually rest; corvée and tax should be eased and the people given respite.
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is orderly and arms are still; levies should be light and the people rested."

sentences.zh: 其令州郡縣隱括貧富，以為三級，其富者租賦如常，中者復二年，下窮者復三年。

translations.literal: Let provinces, commanderies, and districts assess rich and poor in three grades: the rich pay as usual; the middle are exempt two years; the poorest three years.
translations.idiomatic: Let every district rank wealth in three grades: the rich pay as before, the middle are exempt two years, the poorest three."

sentences.zh: 刺史守宰當務盡平當，不得阿容以罔政治。

translations.literal: Governors and magistrates must strive for fairness and must not curry favor to deceive government.
translations.idiomatic: Governors must be fair and must not flatter to cheat the law."

sentences.zh: 明相宣約，咸使聞知。

translations.literal: Proclaim this clearly so all may hear.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim this until all have heard."

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: " On xinmao the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court returned to the capital."

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，行幸河西。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin: traveled to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the third month he went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲戌，秦王赫連昌叛走。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jiaxu: King Helian Chang rebelled and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the intercalary month Helian Chang rebelled and fled.

sentences.zh: 丙子，河西候將格殺之。

translations.literal: On bingzi the garrison commander of Hexi killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Hexi garrison killed him.

sentences.zh: 驗其謀反，羣弟皆伏誅。

translations.literal: His plot was verified; all his younger brothers were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The plot proved true; all his brothers were put to death.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On jimao the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 彭城公元栗進爵為王。

translations.literal: Duke of Pengcheng Yuan Li was advanced to prince.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Li, Duke of Pengcheng, was raised to prince.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，馮文通遣尚書高顒上表稱蕃，詔徵其侍子。

translations.literal: On xinsi Feng Wentong sent Master of Writing Gao Yong with a memorial declaring himself a vassal; an edict summoned his attendant son.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Wentong sent Gao Yong to submit as vassal; the court summoned his heir.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金當川率其眾圍西川侯彭文暉於陰密。

translations.literal: On wuzi Jin Dangchuan led his host to besiege Marquis of Xichuan Peng Wenhui at Yinmi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Dangchuan besieged Peng Wenhui, Marquis of Xichuan, at Yinmi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，詔征西大將軍常山王素討當川。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yimao: an edict that General Who Conquers the West, Prince of Changshan Su, was to campaign against Dangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the fourth month of summer he ordered Prince Su of Changshan against Dangchuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，行幸河西。

translations.literal: On dingwei traveled to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，獲當川，斬之于長安以徇。

translations.literal: On renxu Dangchuan was captured and beheaded at Chang'an as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Dangchuan was taken and beheaded at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the sixth month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，撫軍大將軍、永昌王健，司空、汝陰公長孫道生，侍中古弼，督諸軍討和龍。

translations.literal: On xinhai Grand General Who Inspires Awe, Prince of Yongchang Jian, Minister of Works and Duke of Yiyin Changsun Daosheng, and Palace Attendant Gu Bi directed the armies to campaign against Helong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Prince Jian, Changsun Daosheng, and Gu Bi led the armies against Helong.

sentences.zh: 芟其禾稼。

translations.literal: They cut down the grain.
translations.idiomatic: They destroyed the crops.

sentences.zh: 徙民而還。

translations.literal: They moved the people and returned.
translations.idiomatic: They relocated the people and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，東宮成，備置屯衞，三分西宮之一。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinsi: the Eastern Palace was completed; garrison guards were fully set, one-third of the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the seventh month of autumn the Eastern Palace was finished, with a third of the Western Palace's guard.

sentences.zh: 壬午，行幸美稷，遂至隰城。

translations.literal: On renwu traveled to Meiji and then reached Xicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he went to Meiji and on to Xicheng.

sentences.zh: 命諸軍討山胡白龍于西河。

translations.literal: He ordered the armies to campaign against the Mountain Hu Bai Long in Xihe.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the armies against Bai Long of the Mountain Hu in Xihe.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，克之，斬白龍及其將帥，屠其城。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: he was taken; Bai Long and his commanders were beheaded and the city slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the ninth month Bai Long was taken, he and his officers beheaded, and the city sacked.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guisi: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the tenth month of winter the Rouran sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲午，破白龍餘黨于五原。

translations.literal: On jiawu the remnant band of Bai Long was broken at Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Bai Long's remnant was broken at Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 詔山胡為白龍所逼及歸降者，聽為平民。

translations.literal: An edict that Mountain Hu forced by Bai Long or who came over in surrender were permitted to become commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain Hu coerced by Bai Long or who submitted were made commoners.

sentences.zh: 諸與白龍同惡，斬數千人，虜其妻子，班賜將士各有差。

translations.literal: Those who shared Bai Long's evil were beheaded by the thousands; their wives and children were taken captive and distributed to the generals each according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Long's accomplices were beheaded by the thousands; families were taken and given to the troops by merit.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十有二月甲辰，行幸雲中。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: traveled to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the twelfth month he went to Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 太延元年春正月壬午，降死刑已下各一等。

translations.literal: Taiyan year 1, spring, first month, day renwu: death penalties and below were each reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiyan, first month of spring, on renwu capital punishment and below were reduced one degree.

sentences.zh: 癸未，出太祖、太宗宮人，令得嫁。

translations.literal: On guiwei palace women of Taizu and Taizong were released to marry.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei palace women of Taizu and Taizong were freed to marry.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大赦，改年。

translations.literal: On jiashen general amnesty; the era was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he granted amnesty and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，蠕蠕、焉耆、車師諸國各遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi: the Rouran, Yanqi, Cheshi, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the second month the Rouran, Yanqi, Cheshi, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔長安及平涼民徙在京師，其孤老不能自存者，聽還鄉里。

translations.literal: An edict that people of Chang'an and Pingliang moved to the capital who were old and alone and could not support themselves were permitted to return to their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: Those moved from Chang'an and Pingliang who were old and helpless might return home.

sentences.zh: 丁未，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On dingwei the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，馮文通遣大將渴燭通朝獻，辭以子疾。

translations.literal: Third month, day renhai: Feng Wentong sent the great general Kezhuo Tong with tribute, excusing himself on his son's illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renhai of the third month Wentong sent Kezhuo Tong with tribute, pleading his son's illness.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚申，進宜都公穆壽為宜都王，汝陰公長孫道生為上黨王，宜城公奚斤為恒農王，廣陵公樓伏連為廣陵王，本官各如故。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day gengshen: Duke of Yidu Mu Shou was advanced to Prince of Yidu, Duke of Yiyin Changsun Daosheng to Prince of Shangdang, Duke of Yicheng Xi Jin to Prince of Hengnong, Duke of Guangling Lou Fulian to Prince of Guangling—original offices unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the fifth month Mu Shou, Changsun Daosheng, Xi Jin, and Lou Fulian were raised to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 遣使者二十輩使西域。

translations.literal: Twenty envoys were sent to the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty envoys were sent to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，行幸雲中。

translations.literal: On jiaxu traveled to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he went to Yunzhong.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，詔曰：「頃者寇逆消除，方表漸晏，思崇政化，敷洪治道，是以屢詔有司，班宣恩惠，綏理百揆。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu: an edict said: "Recently the rebel bandits were eliminated and the frontier tables gradually grew calm; We think to exalt government and spread great rule; therefore We have repeatedly ordered the offices to proclaim favor and put the hundred duties in order.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the sixth month an edict said: "Rebels are gone and the borders calm; We mean to govern well and have often ordered offices to proclaim favor."

sentences.zh: 羣公卿士師尹牧守，或未盡導揚之美，致令陰陽失序，和氣不平，去春小旱，東作不茂。

translations.literal: The dukes, ministers, teachers, governors, and magistrates may not have fully guided and displayed excellence, causing yin and yang to lose order and harmonious qi to be unbalanced; last spring there was slight drought and eastern tillage did not flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and magistrates may not have done their part; yin and yang were out of balance; last spring's drought hurt the eastern crops."

sentences.zh: 憂勤克己，祈請靈祇，上下咸秩。

translations.literal: We restrained Ourselves in worry and diligence and prayed to the spirits; above and below were all in place.
translations.idiomatic: We disciplined Ourselves and prayed; order was restored above and below."

sentences.zh: 豈朕精誠有感，何報應之速，雲雨震灑，流澤霑渥。

translations.literal: Could it be that Our sincerity moved them? What a swift response—clouds and rain thundered down and flowing moisture soaked deep.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps Our sincerity was heard—rain fell at once and soaked the land."

sentences.zh: 有鄙婦人持方寸玉印，詣潞縣侯孫家，既而亡去，莫知所在。

translations.literal: A humble woman brought a square-inch jade seal to the house of Marquis Sun of Lu county; afterward she vanished and none knew where she went.
translations.idiomatic: A woman brought a small jade seal to Marquis Sun of Lu county, then vanished without trace."

sentences.zh: 玉色鮮白，光照內映。

translations.literal: The jade was fresh white and shone within.
translations.idiomatic: The stone was bright white and luminous within."

sentences.zh: 印有三字，為龍鳥之形，要妙奇巧，不類人迹，文曰『旱疫平』。

translations.literal: The seal had three characters in dragon-and-bird form, subtle and wondrous beyond human trace, reading 'Drought and plague pacified.'
translations.idiomatic: Three characters in dragon-bird script read, 'Drought and plague pacified.'"

sentences.zh: 推尋其理，蓋神靈之報應也。

translations.literal: Tracing the reason, it is likely the spirits' response.
translations.idiomatic: This was surely the spirits' answer."

sentences.zh: 朕用嘉焉。

translations.literal: We are pleased by it.
translations.idiomatic: We rejoice at it."

sentences.zh: 比者已來，禎瑞仍臻：所在甘露流液，降於殿內；

translations.literal: Recently auspicious omens have come again and again: everywhere sweet dew flowed and descended within the halls;
translations.idiomatic: Lately omens have multiplied: sweet dew fell in the halls;"

sentences.zh: 嘉瓜合蔕，生于中山；

translations.literal: fine melons grew with joined stems in Zhongshan;
translations.idiomatic: fine melons with joined stems grew in Zhongshan;"

sentences.zh: 野木連理，殖於魏郡，在先后載誕之鄉；

translations.literal: wild trees joined in one trunk in Wei commandery, in the district where the empresses were born;
translations.idiomatic: joined trees grew in Wei commandery, birthplace of the empresses;"

sentences.zh: 白燕集于盛樂舊都，玄鳥隨之，蓋有千數；

translations.literal: white swallows gathered at the old capital of Shengle and dark birds followed, numbering perhaps a thousand;
translations.idiomatic: white swallows gathered at old Shengle and dark birds followed by the thousand;"

sentences.zh: 嘉禾頻歲合秀於恒農；

translations.literal: fine grain joined ears for years in Hengnong;
translations.idiomatic: fine grain doubled its ears for years in Hengnong;"

sentences.zh: 白雉、白兔並見於勃海，白雉三隻又集於平陽太祖之廟。

translations.literal: white pheasants and white hares both appeared in Bohai; three white pheasants also gathered at Taizu's temple in Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: white pheasants and hares appeared in Bohai; three white pheasants gathered at Taizu's temple in Pingyang."

sentences.zh: 天降嘉貺，將何德以酬之。

translations.literal: Heaven sends fine gifts—by what virtue shall We repay?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven gives such gifts—what virtue can repay them?"

sentences.zh: 所以內省驚震，欣懼交懷。

translations.literal: Therefore We inwardly examine in shock, joy and fear mingled.
translations.idiomatic: We look within in awe, joy and fear together."

sentences.zh: 其令天下大酺五日，禮報百神，守宰祭界內名山大川，上答天意，以求福祿。

translations.literal: Let the realm feast for five days, rites repay the hundred spirits, and governors sacrifice the famous mountains and great rivers within their borders, answering Heaven's intent and seeking blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Let the empire feast five days; officials sacrifice famous mountains and rivers to answer Heaven and seek blessing."

sentences.zh: 」丙午，高麗、鄯善國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: " On bingwu Gaoli and Shanshan each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Gaoli and Shanshan sent tribute."

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔驃騎大將軍、樂平王丕等五將率騎四萬東伐文通。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict that General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Leping Pi, and five other generals were to lead forty thousand horse east to campaign against Wentong.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he ordered Prince Pi of Leping and five generals with forty thousand horse east against Wentong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，田於棝楊。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: hunted at Yuyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn he hunted at Yuyang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，丕等至於和龍，徙男女六千口而還。

translations.literal: On jimao Pi and the others reached Helong, moved six thousand men and women, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Pi reached Helong, took six thousand people, and returned.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，遂幸河西。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: then traveled to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the eighth month he went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 粟特國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Sogdiana sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the ninth month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，尚書左僕射安原謀反伏誅。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: An Yuan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the tenth month of winter An Yuan plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，行幸定州，次于新城宮。

translations.literal: On jiachen traveled to Ding province and halted at Xincheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he went to Ding and halted at Xincheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十有一月乙丑，行幸冀州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: traveled to Ji province.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the eleventh month he went to Ji.

sentences.zh: 己巳，校獵于廣川。

translations.literal: On jisi conducted a hunt at Guangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he hunted at Guangchuan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，行幸鄴，祀密太后廟。

translations.literal: On bingzi traveled to Ye and sacrificed at the temple of Empress Mi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he went to Ye and sacrificed at Empress Mi's temple.

sentences.zh: 諸所過，對問高年，褒禮賢俊。

translations.literal: Wherever he passed he questioned the aged and honored the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Along the route he questioned the elderly and honored the able.

sentences.zh: 十有二月甲申，詔曰：「操持六柄，王者所以統攝；

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen: an edict said: "To wield the six handles is how the king governs;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the twelfth month an edict said: "The six handles are how a king rules;"

sentences.zh: 平政理訟，公卿之所司存；

translations.literal: to settle government and judge suits is what the dukes and ministers preserve;
translations.idiomatic: settling suits is for ministers;"

sentences.zh: 勸農平賦，宰民之所專急；

translations.literal: to encourage agriculture and level levies is what those who govern the people must urgently attend;
translations.idiomatic: encouraging farming and fair taxes is for those who rule the people;"

sentences.zh: 盡力三時，黔首之所克濟。

translations.literal: to exhaust effort in the three seasons is what the common people can accomplish.
translations.idiomatic: the people must labor through the seasons."

sentences.zh: 各修其分，謂之有序，今更不然，何以為治？

translations.literal: Each should keep to his division—that is called order; now it is otherwise—how can there be rule?
translations.idiomatic: Each should keep his place—that is order; now it is not—how can there be government?"

sentences.zh: 越職侵局，有紊綱紀；

translations.literal: Overstepping office and encroaching on another's charge disorders the statutes;
translations.idiomatic: Overstepping office breaks the law;"

sentences.zh: 上無定令，民知何從？

translations.literal: above there is no fixed command—what are the people to follow?
translations.idiomatic: If the throne gives no fixed order, what can the people follow?"

sentences.zh: 自今以後，亡匿避難，羈旅他鄉，皆當歸還舊居，不問前罪。

translations.literal: From now on those who fled and hid to escape hardship or wandered in other districts shall all return to their former dwellings; past crimes are not asked.
translations.idiomatic: From now fugitives and wanderers shall return home without penalty for past crimes."

sentences.zh: 民相殺害，牧守依法平決，不聽私輒報復，敢有報者，[6]誅及宗族；

translations.literal: When the people kill one another, governors and magistrates shall judge by law and private revenge is not permitted; [6] whoever dares revenge—execution extending to the clan;
translations.idiomatic: Private killing is for magistrates to judge; [6] private revenge brings death to the whole clan;"

sentences.zh: 隣伍相助，與同罪。

translations.literal: neighboring households that aid are guilty as accomplices.
translations.idiomatic: neighbors who help share the guilt."

sentences.zh: 州郡縣不得妄遣吏卒，煩擾民庶。

translations.literal: Provinces, commanderies, and districts must not send clerks and soldiers at will to trouble the people.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces must not send soldiers to harass the people."

sentences.zh: 若有發調，縣宰集鄉邑三老計貲定課，裒多益寡，九品混通，不得縱富督貧，避強侵弱。

translations.literal: If levies are issued, the district magistrate shall gather the village elders of three districts to assess property and fix the levy, gathering more from the many to aid the few, mixing nine grades—rich must not press the poor nor strong harm the weak.
translations.idiomatic: When levies come, elders shall fix fair assessments by wealth, mixing grades so the rich cannot crush the poor."

sentences.zh: 太守覆檢能否，覈其殿最，列言屬州。

translations.literal: The governor shall review ability, verify achievement, and report in order to the province.
translations.idiomatic: Governors shall review work and report to the province."

sentences.zh: 刺史明考優劣，抑退姦吏，升進貞良，歲盡舉課上臺。

translations.literal: The inspector shall clearly assess excellence and baseness, suppress corrupt clerks, advance the upright, and at year's end present accounts to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors shall rank officials, remove the corrupt, promote the good, and report yearly."

sentences.zh: 牧守荷治民之任，當宣揚恩化，奉順憲典，與國同憂，直道正身，肅居官次，不亦善乎？

translations.literal: Governors bear the charge of governing the people; they should proclaim favor, obey the statutes, share the state's worry, keep the straight way and correct the person, and dwell gravely in office—is this not good?"
translations.idiomatic: Governors must teach kindness, obey law, share the state's cares, and keep upright office."

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，遣使者以太牢祀北岳。

translations.literal: " On guimao envoys were sent with the great offering to sacrifice at the Northern Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao envoys sacrificed at the Northern Peak with the great offering."

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, day jiayin: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month of spring, on jiayin the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，馮文通遣使朝貢，求送侍子，帝不許。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi: Feng Wentong sent envoys with tribute, asking to send an attendant son; the Emperor did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the second month Wentong asked to send his heir; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使者十餘輩詣高麗、東夷諸國，詔諭之。

translations.literal: On renchen more than ten envoys were sent to Gaoli and the eastern Yi states with proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen more than ten envoys were sent to Gaoli and the eastern Yi.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，劉義隆遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the third month Liu Yilong sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，平東將軍娥清、安西將軍古弼，率精騎一萬討馮文通，平州刺史元嬰又率遼西將軍會之。

translations.literal: On xinwei General Who Pacifies the East E Qing and General Who Pacifies the West Gu Bi led ten thousand elite horse against Feng Wentong; Governor of Ping province Yuan Ying also led the Liaoxi generals to join them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei E Qing and Gu Bi led ten thousand horse against Wentong; Yuan Ying of Ping brought Liaoxi troops to meet them.

sentences.zh: [7]文通迫急，求救於高麗，高麗使其大將葛蔓盧以步騎二萬人迎文通。

translations.literal: [7] Wentong was pressed hard and begged aid from Gaoli; Gaoli sent its great general Ge Manlu with twenty thousand foot and horse to welcome Wentong.
translations.idiomatic: [7] Wentong, hard pressed, begged Gaoli; Gaoli sent Ge Manlu with twenty thousand men to receive him.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以

translations.literal: On jiaxu, by appointment
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, by appointment

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 鎮虎牢。

translations.literal: He garrisoned Hulao.
translations.idiomatic: He garrisoned Hulao.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，皇子小兒、苗兒並薨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: the imperial sons Xiao'er and Miao'er both died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the fourth month of summer Princes Xiao'er and Miao'er died.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，馮文通奔高麗。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yimao: Feng Wentong fled to Gaoli.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the fifth month Wentong fled to Gaoli.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔散騎常侍封撥使高麗，徵送文通。

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict that Attendant Cadet Feng Bo was envoy to Gaoli to demand Wentong be sent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he sent Feng Bo to Gaoli to demand Wentong.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，行幸河西。

translations.literal: On dingmao traveled to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 赫連定之西也，楊難當竊據上邽。

translations.literal: When Helian Ding went west, Yang Nachang seized Shanggui by stealth.
translations.idiomatic: After Helian Ding went west, Yang Nachang seized Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，詔驃騎大將軍、樂平王丕等督河西、高平諸軍討之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: an edict that General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Leping Pi, and others were to direct the armies of Hexi and Gaoping against him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the seventh month of autumn he ordered Prince Pi of Leping against Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 詔散騎侍郎、廣平子游雅等使於劉義隆。

translations.literal: An edict that Attendant Cadet, Viscount of Guangping You Ya, and others were envoys to Liu Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered You Ya, Attendant Cadet and Viscount of Guangping, to Liu Yilong.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，遣使六輩使西域。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dinghai: six envoys were sent to the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the eighth month six envoys went to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 帝校獵于河西。

translations.literal: The Emperor conducted a hunt in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor hunted in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 詔廣平公張黎發定州七郡一萬二千人，通莎泉道。

translations.literal: An edict that Duke of Guangping Zhang Li was to mobilize twelve thousand men from seven commanderies of Ding province to open the Shaqüan road.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Zhang Li to raise twelve thousand men from seven Ding commands to open the Shaqüan road.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，高車國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On jiachen the Gaoche state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Gaoche sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，驃騎大將軍樂平王丕等至略陽，難當奉詔攝上邽守。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu: General of Agile Cavalry Prince of Leping Pi and the others reached Lüeyang; Nachang received the edict and took charge of Shanggui's defense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the ninth month Pi reached Lüeyang; Nachang obeyed and held Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 高麗不送文通，遣使奉表，稱當與文通俱奉王化。

translations.literal: Gaoli did not send Wentong but sent envoys with a memorial, saying they would submit to royal transformation together with Wentong.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoli refused to send Wentong but offered to submit with him.

sentences.zh: 帝以高麗違詔，議將擊之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Gaoli disobeyed the edict, deliberated striking them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, angered that Gaoli defied the order, considered an attack.

sentences.zh: 納樂平王丕計而止。

translations.literal: He accepted Prince of Leping Pi's plan and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He took Prince Pi's counsel and desisted.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月己酉，行幸棝楊，驅野馬於雲中，置野馬苑。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day jiyou: traveled to Yuyang, drove wild horses in Yunzhong, and established the Wild Horse Park.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the eleventh month of winter he went to Yuyang, rounded up wild horses at Yunzhong, and founded the Wild Horse Park.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬子，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renzi: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the intercalary month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，潁川王提改封武昌王。

translations.literal: On yichou Prince of Yingchuan Ti was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Prince Ti of Yingchuan became Prince of Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 河西王沮渠牧犍，遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Juqu Mujian, King of Hexi, sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Juqu Mujian, King of Hexi, sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾慕璝死。

translations.literal: That year Murong Mugui of Tuyuhun died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Murong Mugui of Tuyuhun died.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸未，征東大將軍中山王纂薨。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, day guiwei: General Who Conquers the East, Prince of Zhongshan Zuan, died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the third year, first month of spring, Prince Zuan of Zhongshan died.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太尉、北平王長孫嵩薨。

translations.literal: On wuzi Grand Tutor, Prince of Beiping Changsun Song, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Changsun Song, Grand Tutor and Prince of Beiping, died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，鎮南大將軍、丹陽王叔孫建薨。

translations.literal: On yisi General Who Guards the South, Prince of Danyang Shusun Jian, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Shusun Jian, Prince of Danyang, died.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，行幸幽州，存恤孤老，問民疾苦；

translations.literal: Second month, day yimao: traveled to You province, comforted the old and orphaned, and inquired into the people's hardships;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the second month he went to You, comforted the aged and orphans, and asked after the people's hardships;

sentences.zh: 還幸上谷，遂至代。

translations.literal: returned and traveled to Shanggu, then reached Dai.
translations.idiomatic: then went to Shanggu and on to Dai.

sentences.zh: 所過復田租之半。

translations.literal: Along the route half the field tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Half the land tax along the route was remitted.

sentences.zh: 高麗、契丹國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Gaoli and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoli and the Khitan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，以南平王渾為鎮東大將軍、儀同三司，鎮和龍。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: Prince of Nanping Hun was made General Who Guards the East, equal ceremony to the Three Excellencies, and garrisoned Helong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Prince Hun of Nanping was made commander of the east and garrisoned Helong.

sentences.zh: 己卯，輿駕還宮。

translations.literal: On jimao the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，龜茲、悅般、焉耆、車師、粟特、疏勒、烏孫、渴槃陁、鄯善諸國各遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On guisi Kucha, Yueban, Yanqi, Cheshi, Sogdiana, Shule, Wusun, Khotan, and Shanshan each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Kucha, Yueban, Yanqi, Cheshi, Sogdiana, Shule, Wusun, Khotan, and Shanshan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，劉義隆遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On dingyou Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Liu Yilong sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏五月己丑，詔曰：「方今寇逆消殄，天下漸晏。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day jichou: an edict said: "At present the rebel bandits are destroyed and the realm gradually grows calm.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the fifth month of summer an edict said: "Rebels are gone and the realm grows calm."

sentences.zh: 比年以來，屢詔有司，班宣惠政，與民寧息。

translations.literal: In recent years We have repeatedly ordered the offices to proclaim favor and give the people rest.
translations.idiomatic: We have often ordered favor and rest for the people."

sentences.zh: 而內外羣官及牧守令長，不能憂勤所司，糾察非法，廢公帶私，更相隱置，濁貨為官，政存苟且。

translations.literal: Yet officials within and without and governors, magistrates, and chiefs cannot diligently attend their charge, investigate the unlawful, abandon public duty for private ends, conceal one another, trade goods for office, and government rests on the perfunctory.
translations.idiomatic: Yet officials and magistrates neglect duty, hide wrongdoing, trade bribes for office, and govern carelessly."

sentences.zh: 夫法之不用，自上犯之，其令天下吏民，得舉告守令不如法者。

translations.literal: When law is not used, the fault begins above; let officers and people throughout the realm be permitted to report governors and magistrates who do not follow the law.
translations.idiomatic: Where law fails, the fault is from the top; let anyone report magistrates who break the law."

sentences.zh: 」丙申，行幸雲中。

translations.literal: " On bingshen traveled to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he went to Yunzhong."

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，使撫軍大將軍、永昌王健，司空、上黨王長孫道生，討山胡白龍餘黨於西河，滅之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuzi: Grand General Who Inspires Awe, Prince of Yongchang Jian, and Minister of Works, Prince of Shangdang Changsun Daosheng, were sent to campaign against the remnant band of Mountain Hu Bai Long in Xihe and destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the seventh month of autumn Prince Jian and Changsun Daosheng destroyed Bai Long's remnant in Xihe.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，行幸河西。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiachen: traveled to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the eighth month he went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the ninth month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遺使者拜西秦王慕璝弟慕利延為鎮西大將軍、儀同三司，改封西平王。

translations.literal: On dingyou envoys were sent to invest Murong Muliyan, younger brother of Western Qin King Mugui, as General Who Guards the West, equal ceremony to the Three Excellencies, and re-enfeoff him as King of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou envoys invested Muliyan as King of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，行幸雲中。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: traveled to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the tenth month of winter he went to Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 十有一月壬申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renshen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the eleventh month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲申，破洛那、者舌國各遣使朝獻，奉汗血馬。

translations.literal: On jiashen Poluo and Zheshe states each sent envoys with tribute, presenting blood-sweating horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Poluo and Zheshe sent tribute, including blood-sweating horses.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河西王沮渠牧犍世子封壇來朝。

translations.literal: That year the heir of Juqu Mujian, King of Hexi, Feng Tan, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That year Feng Tan, heir of Juqu Mujian, came to court.

sentences.zh: 四年春三月庚辰，鄯善王弟素延耆來朝。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring, third month, day gengchen: the younger brother of the King of Shanshan, Su Yanqi, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, third month of spring, on gengchen Su Yanqi, brother of the King of Shanshan, came to court.

sentences.zh: 癸未，罷沙門年五十已下。

translations.literal: On guiwei monks under fifty years of age were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei monks under fifty were dismissed from orders.

sentences.zh: 江陽王根薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Jiangyang Gen died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gen of Jiangyang died.

sentences.zh: 是月，高麗殺馮文通。

translations.literal: That month Gaoli killed Feng Wentong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Gaoli killed Feng Wentong.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day wuyin: general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the fifth month of summer he granted amnesty to the empire.

sentences.zh: 丙申，行幸五原。

translations.literal: On bingshen traveled to Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he went to Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，車駕北伐。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renwu: the imperial carriage campaigned north.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the seventh month of autumn the court marched north.

sentences.zh: 事具蠕蠕傳。

translations.literal: The matter is fully set forth in the treatise on the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: The full account is in the treatise on the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，大饗六軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yichou: a great feast for the Six Armies.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the tenth month of winter he feasted the Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi: the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the twelfth month the court returned from the north.

sentences.zh: 上洛巴泉蕇等相率內附。

translations.literal: Tan and others of Ba Springs in Shangluo led one another inward in submission.
translations.idiomatic: Tan and others of Ba Springs in Shangluo submitted together.

sentences.zh: 詔兼散騎常侍高雅使劉義隆。

translations.literal: An edict that Concurrent Attendant Cadet Gao Ya was envoy to Liu Yilong.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Gao Ya, Concurrent Attendant Cadet, to Liu Yilong.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月庚寅，行幸定州。

translations.literal: Year 5, spring, first month, day gengyin: traveled to Ding province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, first month of spring, on gengyin he went to Ding.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，詔衞大將軍、樂安王範遣雍州刺史葛那取上洛，劉義隆上洛太守鐔長生棄郡走。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingmao: an edict that General of the Guard, Prince of Le'an Fan, was to send Governor of Yongzhou Ge Na to take Shangluo; Liu Yilong's Administrator of Shangluo Tan Changsheng abandoned the commandery and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he ordered Fan to send Ge Na against Shangluo; Tan Changsheng fled.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On xinwei the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以故南秦王世子楊保宗為征南大將軍、秦州牧、武都王，鎮上邽。

translations.literal: On gengyin the former heir of the late King of Southern Qin, Yang Baozong, was made General Who Conquers the South, Governor of Qinzhou, King of Wudu, and garrisoned Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yang Baozong, former heir of Southern Qin, was made King of Wudu and garrisoned Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，鄯善、龜茲、疏勒、焉耆諸國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingyou: Shanshan, Kucha, Shule, and Yanqi each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the fourth month of summer Shanshan, Kucha, Shule, and Yanqi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，治兵於西郊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingchou: troops were drilled at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the fifth month the army was drilled at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遮逸國獻汗血馬。

translations.literal: On guiwei Zheyi state presented blood-sweating horses.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Zheyi presented blood-sweating horses.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，車駕西討沮渠牧犍，侍中、宜都王穆壽輔皇太子決留臺事；

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: the imperial carriage campaigned west against Juqu Mujian; Palace Attendant, Prince of Yidu Mu Shou assisted the crown prince in deciding capital affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the sixth month the court marched west against Juqu Mujian; Mu Shou, Prince of Yidu, assisted the crown prince at the capital;

sentences.zh: 大將軍、長樂王嵇敬，輔國大將軍、建寧王崇二萬人屯漠南，以備蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Grand General, Prince of Changle Ji Jing, and General Who Assists the State, Prince of Jianning Chong, with twenty thousand men encamped in the southern desert against the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Jing of Changle and Prince Chong of Jianning with twenty thousand camped south against the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，車駕至上郡屬國城，大饗羣臣，講武馬射。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jisi: the imperial carriage reached Shang commandery Shuguo city, held a great feast for the ministers, and practiced martial archery on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the seventh month of autumn the court reached Shuguo in Shang, feasted the ministers, and held mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 壬午，留輜重，分部諸軍：撫軍大將軍、永昌王健，尚書令、鉅鹿公劉潔督諸軍，[10]與常山王素二道並進，為前鋒；

translations.literal: On renwu the baggage train was left behind and the armies were divided: Grand General Who Inspires Awe, Prince of Yongchang Jian, and Director of the Masters of Writing, Duke of Julu Liu Jie directed the armies, [10] advancing with Prince of Changshan Su by two routes as vanguard;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu baggage was left behind; Prince Jian and Liu Jie led the armies, [10] advancing with Prince Su of Changshan in two columns as vanguard;

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍、樂平王丕，太宰、陽平王杜超，督平涼、鄜城諸軍為後繼。

translations.literal: General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Leping Pi, and Grand Preceptor, Prince of Yangping Du Chao directed the armies of Pingliang and Fucheng as rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Pi of Leping and Du Chao of Yangping followed with the Pingliang and Fucheng forces.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，永昌王健獲牧犍牛馬畜產二十餘萬。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu: Prince of Yongchang Jian captured more than two hundred thousand of Mujian's cattle, horses, and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the eighth month Prince Jian took more than two hundred thousand head from Mujian.

sentences.zh: 牧犍遣弟董來率萬餘人拒戰於城南，望塵退走。

translations.literal: Mujian sent his younger brother Donglai with more than ten thousand men to resist south of the city; seeing the dust they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Mujian's brother Donglai met them south of the city with ten thousand men and fled at the dust.

sentences.zh: 丙申，車駕至姑臧，牧犍兄子祖踰城來降，乃分軍圍之。

translations.literal: On bingshen the imperial carriage reached Guzang; Mujian's nephew Zuyu came over the wall in surrender; the army was then divided to besiege.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the court reached Guzang; Zuyu surrendered over the wall and the army besieged.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，牧犍兄子萬年率麾下來降。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingxu: Mujian's nephew Wannian led his followers in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the ninth month Wannian surrendered with his men.

sentences.zh: 是日，牧犍與左右文武五千人面縛軍門，帝解其縛，待以藩臣之禮。

translations.literal: That day Mujian, with five thousand civil and military followers, came bound to the camp gate; the Emperor released his bonds and treated him with the ceremony due a frontier prince.
translations.idiomatic: That day Mujian came bound with five thousand followers; the emperor freed him and treated him as a vassal king.

sentences.zh: 收其城內戶口二十餘萬，倉庫珍寶不可稱計。

translations.literal: More than two hundred thousand households within the city and treasures in the storehouses beyond counting were taken.
translations.idiomatic: More than two hundred thousand households and uncounted treasure were taken.

sentences.zh: 進張掖公禿髮保周爵為王，與龍驤將軍穆羆、安遠將軍源賀分略諸郡，雜人降者亦數十萬。

translations.literal: Duke of Zhangye Tufa Baozhou was advanced to prince; Dragon-Agile General Mu Pi and General Who Pacifies the Distance Yuan He divided to reduce the commanderies; mixed peoples who submitted also numbered several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Baozhou of Zhangye was made prince; Mu Pi and Yuan He reduced the districts; hundreds of thousands more submitted.

sentences.zh: 牧犍弟張掖太守宜得，燒倉庫，西奔酒泉；

translations.literal: Mujian's younger brother Yide, Administrator of Zhangye, burned the storehouses and fled west to Jiuquan;
translations.idiomatic: Yide, Zhangye governor and Mujian's brother, burned the stores and fled to Jiuquan;

sentences.zh: 樂都太守安周南奔吐谷渾。

translations.literal: Anzhou, Administrator of Ledu, fled south to Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: Anzhou of Ledu fled south to Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 遣鎮南將軍奚眷討張掖，遂至酒泉，牧犍弟酒泉太守無諱及宜得復奔晉昌。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the South Xi Juan was sent against Zhangye and then reached Jiuquan; Mujian's younger brother Wuwei, Administrator of Jiuquan, and Yide again fled to Jinchang.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Juan took Zhangye and reached Jiuquan; Wuwei and Yide fled again to Jinchang.

sentences.zh: 使弋陽公元潔守酒泉。

translations.literal: Acting Prince of Yiyang Yuan Jie was left to guard Jiuquan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Jie, Acting Prince of Yiyang, was left to hold Jiuquan.

sentences.zh: 鎮北將軍封沓討樂都，掠數千家而還。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the North Feng Ta campaigned against Ledu, plundered several thousand households, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ta, General Who Guards the North, took Ledu, seized several thousand households, and returned.

sentences.zh: 班賜將士各有差。

translations.literal: Rewards were distributed to the generals each according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: The generals were rewarded by merit.

sentences.zh: 戊子，蠕蠕犯塞，遂至七介山，京師大駭。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Rouran raided the frontier and reached Qijie Mountain; the capital was greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Rouran raided to Qijie Mountain and the capital was alarmed.

sentences.zh: 皇太子命上黨王長孫道生等拒之。

translations.literal: The crown prince ordered Prince of Shangdang Changsun Daosheng and others to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince ordered Changsun Daosheng, Prince of Shangdang, to resist.

sentences.zh: 事具蠕蠕傳。

translations.literal: The matter is fully set forth in the treatise on the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: The full account is in the treatise on the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，車駕東還，徙涼州民三萬餘家于京師。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou: the imperial carriage returned east and moved more than thirty thousand households of Liang province to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the tenth month of winter the court turned east and moved more than thirty thousand Liang households to the capital.

sentences.zh: 留驃騎大將軍、樂平王丕，征西將軍賀多羅鎮涼州。

translations.literal: General of Agile Cavalry Prince of Leping Pi and General Who Conquers the West He Duoluo were left to garrison Liang province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Pi of Leping and He Duoluo were left to hold Liang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣張掖王禿髮保周諭諸部鮮卑，保周因率諸部叛於張掖。

translations.literal: On guihai Prince of Zhangye Tufa Baozhou was sent to instruct the Xianbei tribes; Baozhou thereupon led the tribes in rebellion at Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Baozhou was sent to instruct the Xianbei; he rebelled at Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 十有一月乙巳，劉義隆遣使朝獻，并獻馴象一。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi: Liu Yilong sent envoys with tribute, also presenting one trained elephant.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the eleventh month Liu Yilong sent tribute and a trained elephant.

sentences.zh: 是月，高麗及粟特、渴盤陁、破洛那、悉居半諸國各遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: That month Gaoli and Sogdiana, Khotan, Poluo, and Xijuban each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month Gaoli, Sogdiana, Khotan, Poluo, and Xijuban sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十有二月壬午，車駕至自西伐，飲至策勳，告於宗廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu: the imperial carriage returned from the western campaign, held a feast celebrating merit, and reported at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the twelfth month the court returned from the west, feasted the victors, and reported to the temple.

sentences.zh: 楊難當寇上邽，鎮將元勿頭擊走之。

translations.literal: Yang Nachang raided Shanggui; the garrison commander Yuan Wutou drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Nachang raided Shanggui; Yuan Wutou drove him off.

sentences.zh: 是歲，鄯善、龜茲、疏勒、焉耆、高麗、粟特、渴盤陁、破洛那、悉居半等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Shanshan, Kucha, Shule, Yanqi, Gaoli, Sogdiana, Khotan, Poluo, Xijuban, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shanshan, Kucha, Shule, Yanqi, Gaoli, Sogdiana, Khotan, Poluo, Xijuban, and others sent tribute.

translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 昌守將赫連乙升棄城西走 北史卷三六薛辯傳見昌將「東平公乙兠」，這裏「升」當是「斗」之訛，但卷二九奚斤傳亦作「乙升」，今不改。

translations.literal: Chang's garrison commander Helian Yisheng abandoned the city and fled west: Northern History juan 36 biography of Xue Bian records Chang's general 'Duke of Dongping Yi Dou'; here 'Sheng' should be the error for 'Dou,' but juan 29 biography of Xi Jin also reads 'Yi Sheng'—not changed now.
translations.idiomatic: Chang's commander Helian Yisheng abandoned the city and fled west: Northern History juan 36, Xue Bian's biography, has Dongping Duke Yi Dou; here "Sheng" is likely for "Dou," but Xi Jin's biography juan 29 also has Yi Sheng—left unchanged.

sentences.zh: 西奔上邽 據張元濟校勘記，百衲本的底本「上邽」作「上封」，百衲本據他本改。

translations.literal: Fled west to Shanggui: according to Zhang Yuanji's collation notes, the Baizha edition's base text read 'Shangfeng' for 'Shanggui'; the Baizha edition changed it from other editions.
translations.idiomatic: Fled west to Shanggui: Zhang Yuanji notes the Baizha base text had "Shangfeng" for "Shanggui"; Baizha followed other editions.

sentences.zh: 按魏避拓跋珪諱，改「上邽」為「上封」，見卷一０六下地形志下秦州天水郡上封條。

translations.literal: Note: Wei avoided the taboo of Tuoba Gui and changed 'Shanggui' to 'Shangfeng,' as in Geography juan 106b, Tianshui commandery Shangfeng entry.
translations.idiomatic: Wei taboo avoided Tuoba Gui and changed "Shanggui" to "Shangfeng," per Geography juan 106b, Tianshui, Shangfeng.

sentences.zh: 本書作「上邽」者皆後人所改。

translations.literal: Where this book reads 'Shanggui' it was all changed by later men.
translations.idiomatic: Every "Shanggui" in this book was a later restoration.

sentences.zh: 但「上邽」乃漢以來的舊名，上封只行於北魏，今不回改。

translations.literal: But 'Shanggui' is the old name since Han; Shangfeng was used only in Northern Wei—not reverted now.
translations.idiomatic: "Shanggui" is the Han name; Shangfeng was Northern Wei only—not reverted.

sentences.zh: 將軍樓勃別將五千騎圍凡城 諸本「凡」作「瓦」。

translations.literal: General Lou Bo separately led five thousand horse to besiege Fancheng: all editions read 'tile' for 'fan.'
translations.idiomatic: General Lou Bo besieged Fancheng: all editions read "tile" for "fan."

translations.literal: According to Jin shu juan 109 annals of Murong Huang, Murong Ke defeated Shi Hu; Ke 'built a fort at Fancheng and returned.'
translations.idiomatic: Jin shu juan 109: Murong Ke beat Shi Hu and "built a fort at Fancheng and returned."

translations.literal: Jin Taiyuan year 10
translations.idiomatic: Jin Taiyuan year 10

sentences.zh: 〈三八五〉
記慕容垂「遣慕容農出蠮螉塞，歷凡城，趣龍城」。

translations.literal: records Murong Chui 'sent Murong Nong out the Yingying pass, through Fancheng, toward Longcheng.'
translations.idiomatic: records Murong Chui sending Murong Nong through Fancheng toward Longcheng.

sentences.zh: 凡城又見水經注卷一三灅水篇。

translations.literal: Fancheng also appears in Shui jing zhu juan 13, Rao River section.
translations.idiomatic: Fancheng also appears in Shui jing zhu juan 13, Rao River.

sentences.zh: 城當自盧龍出塞攻和龍的要道。

translations.literal: The city must have been on the main road out of Lulong pass to attack Helong.
translations.idiomatic: The city lay on the road from Lulong toward Helong.

sentences.zh: 這裏「瓦城」是「凡城」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Here 'tile city' is the error for 'Fancheng'—now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Here "tile city" is an error for Fancheng—now corrected.

sentences.zh: 〈三八六一頁〉

translations.literal: 〈page 3861〉

sentences.zh: 「元嬰」作「拓跋嬰」。

translations.literal: reads 'Yuan Ying' as 'Tuoba Ying.'
translations.idiomatic: has "Yuan Ying" as "Tuoba Ying."

sentences.zh: 由於這時未改漢姓，所以通鑑改「元」為「拓跋」，却仍單稱「嬰」，則司馬光所見魏書與傳本同，今不改。

translations.literal: Because the Han surname had not yet been adopted, the Comprehensive Mirror changes 'Yuan' to 'Tuoba' but still calls him only 'Ying'; thus Sima Guang's Book of Wei matched the transmitted edition—not changed now.
translations.idiomatic: Han surnames were not yet used; the Mirror writes "Tuoba Ying" but still only "Ying"—Sima Guang's text matched ours; not changed.

sentences.zh: 又通鑑「將軍」作「諸軍」，按文義作「諸軍」是。

translations.literal: Moreover in the Comprehensive Mirror 'general' reads 'generals'—by the sense 'generals' is correct.
translations.idiomatic: In the Mirror "general" is "generals"—by sense correct.

sentences.zh: 甲戌以闕鎮虎牢 按卷一六淮南王他傳稱「除使持節、都督豫洛河南諸軍事、鎮南大將軍、開府儀同三司，鎮虎牢」。

translations.literal: On jiaxu by appointment lacuna garrison Hulao: according to juan 16 biography of Prince Huainan Ta, he was 'made Bearer of Credentials, Commander of Yu, Luo, Henan military affairs, General Who Guards the South, Grand General with Open Office and equal ceremony, garrisoning Hulao.'
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, lacuna, garrison Hulao: juan 16, Prince Huainan Ta, was made commander of Yu, Luo, and Henan, General Who Guards the South, garrisoning Hulao.

translations.literal: Recorded in Yanhe year 3
translations.idiomatic: Recorded in Yanhe year 3

，他隨拓跋燾鎮壓山胡白龍起義後。

translations.literal: , after he followed Tuoba Tao in suppressing the Mountain Hu Bai Long uprising.
translations.idiomatic: , after he followed Tuoba Tao against Bai Long of the Mountain Hu.

sentences.zh: 時間大致相符，疑這裏缺的是以淮南王他為某官等字。

translations.literal: The time roughly matches; it is suspected that what is missing here is the appointment of Prince Huainan Ta to some office and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The date fits; the lacuna likely named Prince Huainan Ta to garrison Hulao.

sentences.zh: 詔兼散騎常侍高雅使劉義隆 按卷四八高允傳，弟推，太延中「兼散騎常侍使劉義隆」，即此高雅無疑。

translations.literal: Edict that Concurrent Attendant Cadet Gao Ya was envoy to Liu Yilong: according to juan 48 biography of Gao Yun, younger brother Tui in Taiyan 'was Concurrent Attendant Cadet envoy to Liu Yilong'—this Gao Ya is without doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Concurrent Attendant Cadet Gao Ya to Liu Yilong: juan 48, Gao Yun—brother Tui in Taiyan was Concurrent Attendant Cadet to Liu Yilong; this must be Gao Ya.

sentences.zh: 推字仲讓，名字相應，作「雅」乃形近而訛。

translations.literal: Tui's style was Zhongrang; name and style correspond—'Ya' is a graphic error near in form.
translations.idiomatic: Tui styled Zhongrang; "Ya" is a graphic error for Tui.

sentences.zh: 撫軍大將軍永昌王健尚書令鉅鹿公劉潔督諸軍 諸本無「督」字，據冊府卷一一六

translations.literal: Grand General Who Inspires Awe Prince of Yongchang Jian, Director of the Masters of Writing Duke of Julu Liu Jie directed the armies: all editions lack the character 'direct'; supplied according to Cefu juan 116
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jian and Liu Jie directed the armies: all editions lack "direct"; supplied from Cefu juan 116

sentences.zh: 悉居半等國並遣使朝貢 按凡稱「是歲」云云，都是分月記載所未及。

translations.literal: Xijuban and other states all sent envoys with tribute: whenever 'that year' is used, it is what the monthly record did not reach.
translations.idiomatic: Xijuban and others sent tribute: "that year" marks what monthly entries omitted.

sentences.zh: 這裏所記鄯善等國，事皆見上四月及十一月，何須又於歲末記載。

translations.literal: The Shanshan and other states recorded here all appear above in the fourth and eleventh months—why record them again at year's end?
translations.idiomatic: Shanshan and the rest already appear in the fourth and eleventh months—why repeat at year's end?

sentences.zh: 疑是後人據北史卷二妄增。

translations.literal: It is suspected to be a later addition based on Northern History juan 2.
translations.idiomatic: Likely a later addition from Northern History juan 2.
